notes.title: New free game coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1844860/extras/1__2_.jpg?t=1639071073[/img]

It's been a while. Since the Steam release of Dissolving, we've been busy with different projects (and still are!). However, life is a bit complicated thing, and because of our main writer being busy with health problems and writing his PhD thesis, the process went really slow. Nevertheless, we finally are ready to release something new on Steam. 

It is Into the Waves, a ~2 hour-ish visual novel we originally made for a game jam. The Steam version is more polished than the original release, but the core content is the same, so we decided to make it free with a donation DLC just like Dissolving. This time the DLC will contain the cocktail menu with recipes and some small bonus tidbits about the characters. 

The visual novel itself is less experimental than Dissolving, but don't worry if you like more "raw" and "punk" approach to storytelling, hopefully we'll have something interesting for you too sooner than later. :)

We plan to release the visual novel around the very end of December.

To the waves!
